findings: The intake station follows Decision 0001 (composable stations): it is defined once in stations/intake/ with station.json and PROMPT.md, consistent with the established station pattern.

The runner's special handling of intake terminal outcomes (rejected, waiting_info) is architecturally sound: the runner orchestrates pipeline execution and responds to station outputs without redefining the station. This pattern is documented in ARCHITECTURE.md under 'Intake outcomes'.
The work order model extensions (intake_outcome, risk, surfaces fields) follow the existing model layer pattern in anvil/model.py with proper serialization in to_dict/from_dict methods.

The rescoped description substitution in _packet_text() ensures downstream stations receive the buildable scope when intake rescopes work, which maintains the integrity of the composable stations pattern.
All changes align with the project's layered architecture: model extensions in the model layer, runner orchestration in the runner layer, and station definition in the station layer.
